idea: Opposite poles pull together and like poles push apart, and the force grows quickly as the gap between the magnets closes.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.why: From almost touching to far enough apart that the pull is weak; both magnets stay on the stage.

parameters.name: flip
parameters.why: Turns the right magnet round, so like poles face each other.

moves: Nothing moves on its own; the right magnet slides as the gap changes and its poles swap when it flips, with the field arrows following.
steps: The field runs from N to S
